summary: Build practical logistics quality skills with ISO 9001, KPI analysis, corrective action, and audit exercises. Explore the five-day course.
lede: Logistics quality management training helps quality, operations, and logistics professionals assess service processes and prepare audit evidence. It covers mapping shipment handoffs, reviewing delivery and damage measures, recording nonconformities and corrective actions, and preparing a logistics audit checklist using ISO 9001 process principles and ISO 19011 audit guidance.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who manage or improve transport, logistics, and supply chain service quality in day-to-day operations.
prerequisites: Working familiarity with transport, logistics, warehouse, or supply chain operations is expected. No coding or programming is required. Bring a laptop with Excel if you want to practise building the KPI scorecard; specialist software is not required.
